name: synergy-studio
description: Make and improve videos with Claude: narrated explainers, ads, footage edits with captions and motion graphics, rendered on this computer.
long_description: Synergy Studio gives Claude tools to plan, build, preview, render and check short videos on your Mac. It writes each video as a small HTML page, speaks narration with a local voice, mixes sound, renders with HyperFrames and checks the result. The first time you ask for a video, Claude runs a one time setup that downloads about 1 GB of tools into your Library folder. Finished videos are saved in Movies/Synergy Studio.
